name: Guangzhou Special 2024

organisers.name: Guangzhou Cubing Organizing Team (广州魔方赛组委)

venue.name: Guangzhou Nanwu Middle School
venue.address: No. 81 Xingyuan Street, Jiangnanxi Rd., Haizhu District
venue.details: multi purpose room on the 3rd floor

information:
All registration must be done online via cubingchina.com.
For Chinese domestic participants, a completed registration is online registration plus prepaid registration fee.
For foreign participants, if you can't pay the fee online via Alipay, please contact the delegate by E-mail right after you finish the onlineregistration. Then we will make a reservation for you by manually accepting your registration and you can pay the fee by cash at the venue. 
Please check the competition website for registration and the other information.
